meta.title: VPN pricing and plans
meta.description: What a GnomeVPN subscription costs: monthly or discounted over a longer period. The first day is free, payment through YooKassa, a refund for the unused period within 14 days.

title: Pricing
intro: One plan, every server. The longer the term, the cheaper the month. Pay through YooKassa and turn auto-renewal off whenever you like.

included.devices: Two devices, more places on request
included.platforms: iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, TV

oneplan.title: One plan rather than several
oneplan.body: We do not split access into tiers: there is no separate price for "fast" servers or for particular countries. Any subscription opens every location and all protocols — Hysteria2, VLESS + Reality and WireGuard. Only the term differs, and a longer one costs less per month. It is built that way because tiering usually serves the sales funnel rather than the user: the entry plan is made deliberately awkward to push you towards the expensive one.

devices.title: How many devices
devices.body: Two devices by default. There is one subscription link; a device takes a place when its app fetches the subscription. A device over the limit gets no servers — remove one you no longer use in your account, or add device places there without changing plan.

payment.title: Paying and renewing
payment.body: On the site, through YooKassa — by card or any other method the payment page offers. Access opens the moment the payment clears — the app sees the new expiry on its next subscription refresh, usually within a few minutes. If no paid period is running — the first time, during the free day or after a break — your payment method is saved and auto-renewal turns on at the full price of the term you chose, with no discount; YooKassa says so on the payment page. It is one button to turn off in your account: access stays until the end of the period you paid for, and nothing is charged after that. You can also extend by hand at any time — the new term is added to the current one.

refund.title: A refund within 14 days
refund.body: If the service does not suit you, write to us within 14 days of paying and we refund the unused period — no interrogation, no request to explain yourself. That is not a marketing line: a VPN cannot be judged from a description, because it behaves differently on different networks, and the only way to know is to try it on your own connection. If you plan to delete your account, request the refund before deleting it.

expiry.title: What happens when it ends
expiry.body: The subscription does not renew itself once you have turned auto-renewal off. When the term expires, connections stop passing authentication — usually within a few hours of the period ending. Your account and your link survive: to come back you only pay again, and nothing has to be set up on your devices a second time.
